description:
We are a team from Oman passionate about engineering, AI, data analysis, and innovation. Our project, TerraShift AI, aims to use NASA data to support smarter agricultural decisions and climate adaptation.

We welcome motivated teammates with skills in mathematics, statistics, Python, data analysis, agriculture, or web development. We value creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving, and we are excited to work together to develop a practical solution to a real-world challenge. 🚀🌱
summary:
TerraShift AI is an advanced Android application designed to combat agricultural challenges in arid regions like Oman by optimizing crop rotation through satellite intelligence.
We built a smart mobile application powered by Kotlin, Google Maps SDK, and TensorFlow Lite, integrated directly with the NASA POWER API to fetch real-time climate and soil metrics (GWETROOT, TS, T2M, and PRECTOT) based on the farmer's exact geographic location.

How it addresses the challenge: By allowing farmers to drop a pin on an interactive map, the system analyzes local soil moisture and thermal thresholds, matching them with scientifically backed crop sequences to prevent soil nutrient depletion and reduce heavy reliance on synthetic fertilizers.
In arid climates facing severe water scarcity and soil degradation, TerraShift AI transforms complex NASA space data into actionable, localized recommendations. It increases land stability from 65% to 88% and empowers farmers to make sustainable, data-driven decisions that secure long-term agricultural productivity and food security.
details:
Project Overview: TerraShift AI is an innovative Android application designed to revolutionize sustainable farming in arid regions (such as Oman) by providing real-time, satellite-driven crop rotation planning.

  • What it does & how it works: The application allows farmers to pin their exact field location on an interactive Google Maps interface. Upon selecting a location, the system integrates with the NASA POWER API to fetch live, real-time climate and soil telemetry metrics—including root-zone soil wetness (GWETROOT), soil/air temperature (TS and T2M), and precipitation (PRECTOT). It combines this satellite data with a local TensorFlow Lite plant disease analysis model and scientifically backed agricultural rules to recommend the optimal crop sequence.
  • Benefits: It directly tackles critical agricultural hurdles in arid climates by preventing soil nutrient depletion, optimizing water retention through crop residue management, naturally fixing soil nitrogen via legumes, and minimizing heavy reliance on costly synthetic fertilizers.
  • Intended Impact: TerraShift AI transforms complex space telemetry into simple, actionable local insights. Case studies in arid regions demonstrate an increase in land stability and soil health from 65% (traditional continuous farming) to 88% (smart rotation), empowering local communities to achieve long-term food security and climate resilience.
  • Tools & Technologies Used: Built using Kotlin in Android Studio, leveraging Google Maps SDK, Android Location Services (FusedLocationProviderClient), NASA POWER API, TensorFlow Lite,
